Not to be confused with Team Rocket's mechas.
----
This is a list of all of the arsenal used by Team Rocket, including vehicles, weapons, and gadgets that the Team Rocket trio and the organization as a whole have used over the course of , and certain based on the series. Simple items such as shovels, small clamps, gloves, bell jars or appliances that run on 's shocks are also excluded from this list.

==In animation==
===Binoculars===
 
In every series, the trio uses special binoculars with large zoom-in features for viewing at a distance. These binoculars have been frequently used to help the trio spy from high positions.

 
Team Rocket Binoculars OS.png|Binoculars used in the original series
Team Rocket Binoculars BW.png|Binoculars used in 
Team Rocket Binoculars XY.png|Binoculars used in 
 

===Road vehicles===
 
The trio sometimes use jeeps, trucks or vans to execute their schemes.
 
File:TR Indigo League Checkup Van.png|A Pokémon check-up van in A Friend In Deed
File:TR Ambulance EP126.png|An ambulance for stealing Pokémon in The Chikorita Rescue
File:EP132 TR Tractor.png|A tractor with detachable storage in For Crying Out Loud
 

===Drone===
 ]]
Team Rocket owns a special drone that they have used in the episode New Places - Familiar Faces! and the episode Coming Back Into the Cold!. It can fly around with a propeller and is equipped with a small video camera that syncs to a screen on the Meowth Balloon, as well as a video recorder to track sound from its surroundings. Team Rocket occasionally uses this device to spy on and whenever they can't directly sneak up on and eavesdrop on their conversations.
